'''Simonelle's workshop''' was a laboratory operated by an [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]], the brilliant doctor and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] engineer named [[Simonelle]] the [[Ingoian]]. The workshop was located in a hidden enclave somewhere in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. 

==History==
This location was where Simonelle's [[Human replica droid]]s were developed and created, including [[Guri]]. After Guri Simonelle proceeded in making [[Simonelle (droid)|a replica of himself]], as well as other droids, based on his gained experience. The workshop was filled with incomplete droids, lacking [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]], and computers programming their [[Verbobrain/Legends|Verbobrains]]

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Guri, under the orders of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], returned to Simonelle's workshop in order to kill the Ingoian scientist so that the technology that made Guri remained unique. Guri easily eliminated what she thought was her target, but in reality it was the replica droid working there. Simonelle himself was in a distant place, watching this through a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]]. Guri removed the [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] from the [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]], but neglected destroying the workshop and the existing technology.

With this droid was destroyed, and Simonelle used the confrontation to fake his death and go into hiding.
